owner: Host CI adapter; no duplicate matrix launcher in this package
mandatory_before_timing: owner production native differential and invalidation/publication gates
pair_acceptance: Always retain pair report, including on capture failure. Require exit0, accepted:true, failures:[], two valid arms.
arm_input_variance: Only manifest.style_source.sha256 and corresponding style source bytes vary by pinned arm; raw clone paths differ but verified typed registry identities normalize clone-relatively
candidate_activity: Every candidate accepted style_witness has positive selected-same-instance workload_counter_deltas.lookups and .hits; preserve all snapshots and all other counter deltas as unsynchronized diagnostics
heartbeat_report: Use complete heartbeat_evidence.records, producer_lateness_ms, dispatch_latency_ms, handler_gap_ms, after_stop, stop_handler_gap_ms; closed-loop responsiveness only
style_report: Preserve absolute snapshots and workload_baseline/style_list_replaced_on_open, workload_counter_deltas and delta_scope; never subtract IDs from separate trials/style instances
failure_policy: Retain all failed/partial trials, stdout/stderr, raw outputs, manifests, diffs, native logs and exit statuses; zero skipped native tests; no early speed claim, reruns replacing failures, outlier deletion or deadline widening
not_acceptance: No universal speed threshold, first-getter bound, arbitrary-extension proof, physical latency claim or default-on decision
